task_completion.description: The agent successfully loads the spine CT volume into the 3D Slicer interface.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 3D Slicer application is open and a CT scan of a spine is visible in the slice viewers (Red, Green, Yellow views).

task_completion.description: The agent uses a measurement tool (e.g., Markups Line) to measure the anterior height of the L1 vertebral body.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement line or ruler is visible on the anterior (front) edge of the L1 vertebra in the sagittal view, with a distance value displayed.

task_completion.description: The agent uses a measurement tool to measure the posterior height of the L1 vertebral body.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement line or ruler is visible on the posterior (back) edge of the L1 vertebra in the sagittal view, with a distance value displayed.

task_completion.description: The agent calculates the compression ratio and determines the severity classification.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent may be seen using a calculator, or typing the ratio (approx 0.89) and classification ('Normal') into a text editor or terminal.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the measurements and classification to the specified JSON file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command (e.g., 'cat' or 'echo') or a text editor shows the creation of '~/Documents/SlicerData/Exports/l1_compression_measurements.json' containing the required fields: vertebral_level, anterior_height_mm, posterior_height_mm, compression_ratio, and classification.

integrity.description: The agent performed measurements using the 3D Slicer GUI tools rather than just generating a file via script.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Slicer's 'Markups' or 'Ruler' tools and lines appearing over the anatomy.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply write the JSON file immediately after opening the application without performing measurements.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows a sequence of actions within Slicer (scrolling, placing points) before the final file is saved.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the 3D Slicer application interface rather than using terminal-only commands to manipulate the data.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 3D Slicer window is the active window during the measurement phase of the task.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The L1 vertebra in this synthetic scan has an anterior height of 28.5 mm and a posterior height of 32.0 mm. The resulting compression ratio is approximately 0.8906. According to the Genant semi-quantitative method, this ~11% height loss is classified as 'Normal' (Grade 0). The agent's saved JSON should closely reflect these values.
